$schema_note: Sidebar / Page 1 input widget definitions -- the mission-parameter form. Field ids match the parameter names used in aircraft.py's Aircraft dataclass and mission.py's build_mission_profile(), so form values can be passed straight through without renaming.

inputs.label: Cruise speed (km/h)
inputs.unit_conversion: internally converted to m/s (cruise_speed_kmh / 3.6) before being passed to physics.py

inputs.label: Cruise altitude (m)
inputs.notes: Note: current mission.py hardcodes climb_alt_m = 3000.0 for the cruise/loiter altitude; wiring this slider through requires parameterizing that constant.

inputs.label: Loiter time (min)
inputs.maps_to: mission.py loiter segment target -- currently computed as the MAXIMUM achievable loiter time given fuel/battery budget (mission._max_loiter_time()), not a fixed target. Wiring this slider in as a target-duration cap (rather than letting the simulator find the max) is a behavior change worth deciding on deliberately.

action_buttons.label: Train RL
action_buttons.performance_note: Slowest of the three buttons. Cache the trained model with st.cache_resource so it is not retrained on every Streamlit script rerun.
action_buttons.graceful_degradation: If gymnasium/stable-baselines3 are not installed, train() returns False and RLController.predict() automatically falls back to the rule-based policy -- the dashboard should surface this fallback state to the user rather than silently proceeding.
